interpretation: Observed actions support these design hypotheses. Triggers and implementation choices are proposed abstractions, not recovered internal reasoning or an exact execution graph.

patterns.observed: The session searched for acquisition/parent information, opened Sona's subsidiary-statements page, and downloaded NOVELIC and subsidiary filings.
patterns.trigger: A relevant parent, subsidiary, acquirer or related entity has been identified with evidence.
next_actions: Discover the related entity's official disclosure pages.
Select documents that explicitly concern the subject company.
patterns.efficient_implementation: DeepSeek entity/relation extraction plus targeted web search, Crawl4AI HTML retrieval and a bounded related-domain queue.
patterns.validation: Distinguish a search hypothesis from a supported relationship, and direct ownership from ultimate economic interest.
patterns.limitation: The first query already includes Sona; the visible trace does not establish where that initial hypothesis originated.

patterns.observed: The session searched Infineon and other counterpart sites and opened an Analog Devices partner page.
patterns.trigger: A named partner/customer/owner claim needs corroboration.
next_actions: Search the named counterparty's official domain for the subject.
Extract the precise relationship and dates.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Small query generation and result assessment followed by source-specific extraction on Crawl4AI content.
patterns.validation: A partner directory corroborates partnership, not customer revenue, ownership, exclusivity or internal tool deployment.
patterns.limitation: The trace shows searches/opens, not a complete proof ledger for every relationship in the report.

patterns.observed: The session downloaded PDF statements, extracted text, rendered pages, rotated sideways pages and inspected images.
patterns.trigger: A selected source is a PDF or extracted text is insufficient to interpret a table.
next_actions: Render/OCR or inspect only pages requiring visual interpretation.
patterns.efficient_implementation: HTTP download plus a PDF parser; targeted OCR/vision fallback alongside Crawl4AI for HTML.
patterns.validation: Retain page references, table headers, units, signs, accounting period and subject entity.
patterns.limitation: Sixteen image inspections in this snapshot are observed actions, not a recommended fixed inspection budget.

patterns.observed: Downloaded documents were saved once and searched repeatedly with rg/sed; independent downloads were batched.
patterns.trigger: Multiple objectives or questions concern the same source documents.
next_actions: Store a content-addressed source snapshot and parsed representation.
Retrieve relevant passages with surrounding headings/table context.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Cached source store, local text search and bounded excerpt extraction; concurrent independent fetches.
patterns.validation: Every extracted claim must link to the original source and section/page. Reuse must not hide stale documents or cut away attribution.

patterns.observed: The session compared an older production expectation with later parent earnings-call guidance and revisited the exact launch passage.
patterns.trigger: Two sources disagree about the same event, status, specification or date.
next_actions: Retain both claims with publication/event dates and scope.
Keep the conflict unresolved when sources concern different products or entities.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Structured claim comparison in code; targeted search and a focused DeepSeek evidence comparison.
patterns.validation: Newer does not automatically mean superseding. Do not turn an announced production plan into actual shipments.

patterns.observed: The session parsed Careers links and found the external novelic.oneassessment.com job board.
patterns.trigger: A company's careers page links to hosted job advertisements.
next_actions: Resolve the explicitly linked employer job board.
Fetch relevant individual job descriptions when researching specific tools and applications.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Crawl4AI links plus bounded same-employer external crawling; small-model job and named-tool extraction.
patterns.validation: Job URLs can establish recruiting navigation. A job title alone does not establish a technology or commercial service.
patterns.limitation: Full individual-ad extraction is a proposed continuation; it is not demonstrated by these link-enumeration events.

patterns.observed: The session separated accounting bases in its commentary and used Python to calculate changes and ratios from extracted values.
patterns.trigger: A requested metric can be derived from sourced inputs with matching entity, currency, units and period definitions.
next_actions: Calculate deterministically and retain formula plus source input IDs.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Typed extracted financial facts plus ordinary calculation code, with the LLM resolving textual definitions only where needed.
patterns.validation: Do not combine Serbian calendar-year standalone and parent March-year-end consolidated figures as like-for-like observations.
patterns.limitation: This is an optional financial-research capability beyond the current crawler's principal extraction objectives; calculations and inputs require separate verification.

patterns.observed: Later searches covered patents, EU research projects, certification, current production and competitors rather than repeating the first broad query.
patterns.trigger: An objective remains unresolved and a concrete source class or query could resolve it.
next_actions: Generate targeted searches from missing facts and discovered identifiers.
Evaluate whether new evidence changes coverage; stop when further work is unlikely to add useful information.
patterns.efficient_implementation: Coverage and claim state in code, with small-model query selection and a bounded search/fetch loop.
patterns.validation: Preserve not-found versus not-assessed; keep generic formats/capabilities out of technology identities. Avoid open-ended competitor/reputation research unless requested.
patterns.limitation: A universal stopping policy cannot be inferred from one unfinished research session.
